pictures.author: Bahnfrend
pictures.observations: Complete1280x852 entrance picture inspected. Northern low granite gate with straight rectangular open red-jamb door, gold sign/couplet bands, green ceramic eave teeth, paired curling ridge figures/central turquoise pearl, two red lanterns, broad steps, stone balustrades and paired guardian lions. Boulders and hillside stair route rise behind. Trees/people are host context.

pictures.author: Santosdo
pictures.observations: Complete1280x853 ordinary interior inspected. Red painted round posts, warm/gold shrine trim, many hanging incense coils and real shaded interior depth. This establishes timber/material palette; dense furnishings and exact inscriptions are outside the exterior viewer model.

pictures.author: Abasaa
pictures.observations: Complete1280x960 ordinary facade picture inspected. Distinct main compound front: red walls, pale trim around a tall round arch, lattice side openings, green tiles and strongly swept ridge tips, gold plaque, slim stacked red/white pagoda to viewer-right, lower green porch and pale stone terrace balustrade. Temporary event trussing is omitted. Main facade differs from the northern granite entrance.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Two mapped temple controls: main terraced compound with red round-arched front hall, lattice openings, green/grey upturned roof ranges, slender diminishing seven-tier pagoda form and open inner courts; plus the separate northern granite entrance with a genuine open doorway, green tiled cornice, paired ridge ornaments/central pearl, red lanterns, approach steps and simplified guardian lions. Preserve independent buildings and native hillside. Hall allocation, open-court dimensions and terrace/roof subdivision inside the broad mapped compound are picture-led approximations; no exact hidden-room or furnishing inventory.
